about_short_description.short_description: De.Fi is the Inventor of Crypto's First Antivirus and Web3 SuperApp.

product.name: De.Fi Antivirus
product.description: A tool that audits smart contracts and detects fraudulent activities like rug pulls to protect users from scams in the crypto space.

product.name: De.Fi Rekt Database
product.description: A comprehensive database cataloging over 2,500 DeFi scams, hacks, and exploits, providing detailed information on each event to help users avoid risks.

product.name: De.Fi Scanner
product.description: A smart contract auditing tool that provides real-time security assessments of contracts, including code analysis and risk evaluation.

product.name: De.Fi Shield
product.description: A wallet security tool that monitors user wallets for exposure to risky contracts and enables revocation of permissions to suspicious contracts.

product.name: De.Fi Portfolio Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard that consolidates and displays users' crypto holdings, staking, lending, and transaction history across multiple blockchains in real-time.

product.name: De.Fi Explore Yields
product.description: A tool integrated into the De.Fi dashboard that helps users discover and analyze yield farming and staking opportunities across multiple DeFi platforms.
